approach: Extend the existing decision gate rather than add a new one. `decision_gate` in crates/athena-core/src/run/checks.rs:21 is already called from the producer loop (`unreconciled_in_snapshot`, producer.rs:499) and again at the candidate (`unreconciled_decisions`, mod.rs:1944). Beside `unreconciled`, add a pure `unresolved_links(list, log)` in athena-data. It parses the log's supersession phrases and reports every `[[link]]` whose (older, newer) pair no phrase in the log names, or whose ids are not log entries. To make that possible without a cli dependency, move the phrase parse (`parse_supersessions`, `Hit`, `HitKind`, `Parsed` and their helpers) from athena-cli backtest.rs into athena-data/decision_links.rs. backtest re-exports them, so there is one parser. `decision_gate` runs the new check only when `docs/decisions.md` is in the changed paths. It reuses `GATE_REASON_PREFIX`, so the send-back and the retry reader (reading/retry.rs:491) carry the message unchanged. Key links on ids: drop `line` from `Link` (decisions.rs:47) and from the toml, and match on (older, newer) in `Link::matches`, `unlisted` and `not_found`. Duplicate pairs in the toml (D46/D79, D87/D88) merge into one entry each. Add a pure `citing_lines(decisions, docs)` in athena-data. The candidate gate prints its hits as advisory UI lines: lines of docs/**/*.md other than decisions.md that cite the `older` id of a link the change adds. It never fails the job. Record the change as D187, which amends D156, with one new link D156→D187. Update decision-sets.md §8 step 2 and the CHANGELOG. The D08 re-queue and the failure-class record are Athena actions outside this diff.

decisions.choice: A link resolves when its (older, newer) pair is named by a supersession phrase of the log, using the backtest's own parse, moved into athena-data.
decisions.reason: This is condition (a) of the backtest (backtest.rs:306), which today runs only in `cargo test` at the final verdict. Running the same rule in the producer loop removes the late catch, and one parser means the two cannot drift. Moving the parse is needed because athena-core cannot depend on athena-cli (system facts, crate reach).

rejected.option: Resolve only means both ids are `## D<n>` headings
rejected.why: A link with no phrase would pass the loop and still fail the backtest at the final verdict, which is the failure being removed.

rejected.option: Reimplement a phrase scan inside athena-core
rejected.why: A second parser would drift from the backtest's.

decisions.choice: Drop `line` from `Link` and match on (older, newer). Parsing still ignores a stray `line` key, because neither `Link` nor `Pair` denies unknown fields.
decisions.reason: A line number is the root cause of the shifts in jobs 20261104-153450-y72x and 20261010-225741-yvk0. The base list of a running job may still carry `line`, and it must still parse (decision_links.rs:69-73).

rejected.option: Keep `line` optional and still compare it when present
rejected.why: A stale number would keep failing as before.
It would make the base list of an in-flight job unreadable.

decisions.choice: Run the resolve check for every job whose changed paths include docs/decisions.md. It judges the candidate's list against the candidate's log, and only when the base has a readable list.
decisions.reason: This is what the request says. It reuses the existing early return for an empty base list (checks.rs:27) and the warning-and-skip for an unreadable base list (checks.rs:641), so repos without a list and the repair path are unchanged.

rejected.option: Also run it when only decision-links.toml changes
rejected.why: Outside the request. The backtest test still covers that case.

decisions.choice: The sentence listing is advisory UI lines at the candidate gate (`unreconciled_decisions`, which has `ctx.ui`). It is built by a pure function `citing_lines` over docs/**/*.md except decisions.md, and it matches the id as a whole token.
decisions.reason: Listing is a heuristic on ids and cannot read meaning, so it must not fail a job. Printing in the loop would need a producer.rs edit, which is out of scope.

rejected.option: Fail the job on a citing line
rejected.why: A false positive would block jobs and the user asked for a list.

rejected.option: Print from producer.rs in the loop
rejected.why: producer.rs is out of scope for this job.

decisions.choice: Update the `reconciling_edits` fixture in run/tests.rs so the new entry says `Amends D02` and its link has no `line`. Leave the gate's existing wording unchanged.
decisions.reason: The fixture's entry (tests.rs:3181) has no phrase, so it would now be unresolved. That is correct behavior, and the fixture should model a real reconciling entry. The exact-text test at tests.rs:3371 keeps passing because the unreconciled message is untouched.

rejected.option: Loosen the check so the fixture passes
rejected.why: It would re-open the gap the request closes.

Move the four parse tests with them. Add `Unresolved` (older, newer and the reason: unknown older entry, unknown newer entry, or no phrase) and `unresolved_links(list_text, log_text) -> Result<Vec<Unresolved>, String>`. It uses `link_pairs` and `parse_supersessions(log)`, and `Err` means the list does not parse. Add unit tests for the broken pair, an unknown id and a log shifted by inserted lines.

Add `Citation` and `citing_lines(decisions: &[String], docs: &[(String, String)]) -> Vec<Citation>`. It matches the id as a whole token on every line and skips docs/decisions.md. Add unit tests for the token forms `D08`, `D08's`, `(D08)`, `D080`, `D8`, a prefix word.

In athena-cli/backtest.rs, `pub use athena_data::decision_links::{Hit, HitKind, Parsed, parse_supersessions}` and delete the moved code. Keep `standing`. In check_parse (backtest.rs:324-332) drop the line from the not-found reason.

Update the unit-test fixtures (lines 409-411, 428, 442, 536-537) and fix the unlisted/unfound test to use a pair not in the log. Add a test that an old-format list with `line` still parses, plus the real-list tests (no `line`, no duplicate pair, resolves with `unresolved_links`).

In athena-core/src/run/checks.rs, extend `decision_gate`. When the base list is non-empty and `changed` contains the log path, call `unresolved_links` on the candidate texts. Build the reason with `GATE_REASON_PREFIX`: the existing unreconciled message unchanged, a link sentence appended or alone, naming each pair and the phrase to write. An unparsable candidate list is its own finding. In `unreconciled_decisions`, after a clean or failing reason, print `decisions  note: <path>:<line> cites <id>, which this change amends: <line text>` for each `citing_lines` hit. The ids are the `older` ids of links in the candidate list that are not in the base list. Read docs through `git.ls_tree_under(candidate, "docs/")` and `committed_text`; skip files that are not `.md`.

In athena-core/src/run/tests.rs, fix `reconciling_edits` (entry text `Amends D02`, link without `line`). Add the broken-link list constant and the tests: edit without decisions.md lands, edit with decisions.md and a broken link closes with the prefix and producer=2/verifier=0, and a docs/guide.md citing D02 gives the note and the job lands.

Edit crates/athena-cli/tests/backtest.rs: drop `line` from LINKS, change `has(...)` to ignore the line, compare the hit-pair set with the link-pair set (not `hits.len() == links.len()`), and add the test that inserts 25 lines into a copy of the real log.

Append D187 to docs/decisions.md (next id after D186, Provenance bullet, `Amends D156` once, no other phrase). Edit decision-sets.md §8 step 2 and add the CHANGELOG [Unreleased] entry.
Run `cargo fmt --all`, then `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` and `cargo test --locked`, and fix findings in the files listed.

risks.risk: D187's text accidentally contains `amends`, `supersedes` or `superseded by` and creates an unlisted hit, which is a condition-a finding.
risks.mitigation: The entry holds the phrase `Amends D156` once and no other. The real-log backtest test catches a stray one, and step 8 runs it.

risks.risk: The advisory listing is noisy because many docs cite D08.
risks.mitigation: Cap the printed lines per decision (20, then `and N more`). The listing is UI only and never fails the job.

risks.risk: The step that moves the parse breaks a test that calls the now-private helpers or imports from backtest.
risks.mitigation: The helpers' tests move with them, and `backtest` re-exports every public item that other crates and tests used (decisions.rs:24, tests/backtest.rs:4).

risks.risk: The in-loop listing is missing: the loop sends back on a failing gate but prints no advisory lines until the candidate gate.
risks.mitigation: Printing in the loop would need a producer.rs edit, which is out of scope. The candidate gate runs before the PR and the verifier and prints the lines in the job log.
